name: usage-hud
description: A HUD above the prompt: turn, context window, prompt-cache TTL countdown, 5-hour and weekly limits with reset countdown, and session cost — with colors and animations that change as you go.

terminal_icons.title: Terminal icons
terminal_icons.description: nerd: Nerd Font icons (needs a Nerd Font in your terminal). unicode: plain symbols that work in any font. emoji: bigger, colored icons, two cells each.

terminal_style.title: Terminal style
terminal_style.description: minimal: one bare row, ▰▱ meters, the session at the left and the limits at the right. card: a rounded box with icon badges (3 rows). line: the card's row without the box.

cache_ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cache_ttl.description: How long the main conversation's prompt cache lives after each response. auto: 1h on a subscription within its plan, 5m on usage credits, an API key or a cloud provider (Claude Code's defaults). Set 5m or 1h if you changed promptCacheTtl or a TTL env var. A /model switch reports the real one and the HUD adopts it.
